name: Merab (Saul's daughter)
title: King Saul's eldest daughter
summary: Merab was King Saul's eldest daughter, who was first promised to David as a wife after his victory over Goliath. However, Saul broke the promise and gave her instead to Adriel from Meholah. Her five sons were later executed by the Gibeonites in revenge for Saul's actions.

keyEvents.title: Promised to David
keyEvents.description: After David's victory over Goliath, Saul promised him his eldest daughter Merab as a wife as a reward.

keyEvents.title: Saul breaks the promise
keyEvents.description: Saul gave Merab to Adriel of Meholah instead of giving her to David, even though he had promised her to David.

keyEvents.title: Her Sons Are Handed Over
keyEvents.description: Merab's five sons with Adriel were handed over to the Gibeonites by King David to atone for Saul's bloodguilt against them.
